mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_applications (user_id, job_id, resume_id, employer_id, cover_letter, status, deleted) VALUES (#{userId}, #{jobId}, #{resumeId}, #{employerId}, #{coverLetter}, #{status}, #{deleted})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_applications WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND job_id = #{jobId} AND deleted = 0

SELECT id, user_id AS userId, job_id AS jobId, resume_id AS resumeId, employer_id AS employerId, cover_letter AS coverLetter, status, deleted, create_time AS createTime, update_time AS updateTime FROM t_applications WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId} AND deleted = 0

SELECT id, user_id AS userId, job_id AS jobId, resume_id AS resumeId, employer_id AS employerId, cover_letter AS coverLetter, remark, status, deleted, create_time AS createTime, update_time AS updateTime FROM t_applications WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
mapper.update: UPDATE t_applications SET status = #{status}, remark = #{remark}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id AS userId, job_id AS jobId, resume_id AS resumeId, employer_id AS employerId, cover_letter AS coverLetter, status, deleted, create_time AS createTime, update_time AS updateTime FROM t_applications WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND deleted = 0 AND status = #{status} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{size}
SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS total FROM t_applications WHERE job_id = #{jobId} AND deleted = 0 GROUP BY status
